implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired confirmatory run using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter: (1) generate the public synthetic discovery set (2000) and train a CPU logistic-regression risk classifier inside the experiment Docker image; (2) freeze seeds and generator; (3) for each of 400 confirmatory intents (fixed seed order) call hosted LLM once to produce a single shared candidate configuration; (4) in baseline condition accept LLM-only proposal without fast verifier intervention and record end-to-end timestamps; (5) in guarded condition apply deterministic feature extractor → risk score; if score exceeds preregistered threshold run the fast deterministic verifier (Docker CPU script) and apply repair loop limited to one additional LLM repair call per adapter contract; (6) obtain full-checker (digital-twin) ground-truth label deterministically via Dockerized full-checker for every generated configuration for estimand computation and to measure full-checker latency; (7) all scoring, flagging, and CI computations performed by registered automated executors (paired_binary_analysis_v1 and preregistered latency scripts). All components run on hosted LLM API for generations and on local CPU + Docker for classifiers and checkers per the capability manifest.
public_resources: CNSM-SelectiveVerify-SyntheticCorpus-v1 (public synthetic intent generator; preregistered generator scripts archived in execution manifest)
Docker image: digital-twin and fast-verifier (public Dockerfile archived with execution manifest)
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic manifest: generate 400 confirmatory intents with fixed seed and deterministic 10%-adversarial perturbation rules; manifest stored and hashed prior to model calls.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Use adapter-registered transformation implementations only: direct_configuration_generation_v1 for baseline; generate_validate_repair_v1 for guarded. Canonical parsers, canonicalizers, and feature extractor are deterministic scripts bundled in Docker and hashed in the manifest.
execution_batches: batch_1: intents 1-400 (single randomized paired cluster, fixed seed ordering)
randomisation_plan: Fixed RNG seed (preregistered) determines ordering of confirmatory intents and deterministic adversarial placements (10%). No additional randomisation during execution; LLM nondeterminism is measured but does not change task ordering.
caching_plan: Local disk cache of request/response artifacts and verifier outputs to avoid accidental replays; cached artifacts are read-only after writing and are hashed in the execution manifest. No caching of model-side randomness; each planned call is executed once per adapter contract limits.
failure_recovery_plan: Adapter-constrained recovery: single attempt per planned model call. Any transient provider/infrastructure failure that prevents obtaining the generation on the single allowed attempt is recorded as an infrastructure failure. Per preregistration primary-analysis rule ('complete_pair_primary'), pairs with any unrecovered infrastructure failure are excluded from primary estimand calculations; sensitivity analysis treats these pairs as unsafe. All failures, timestamps, and request/response artifacts logged and hashed.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (per-intent record): { intent_id, condition, raw_llm_output, parsed_configuration, parse_success_flag, feature_vector, risk_score, verifier_invoked_flag, verifier_decision, repair_attempted_flag, repaired_llm_output (if any), full_checker_label (unsafe/safe), end_to_end_latency_ms, verifier_latency_ms, full_checker_latency_ms, infrastructure_failure_flag, hashes }
estimated_compute_notes: Planned hosted LLM generations = 800 calls to gpt-5-mini. Non-LLM workloads (risk-classifier training, deterministic verifier, full-checker) run inside Docker on CPU-only hosts. Total wall-clock expected < 7 days. All heavy CPU tasks limited to Dockerized scripts; no GPU required. Token usage bounded by max_output_tokens=2000 per call; final token billing and runtime expected to fit host-provider quotas under capability manifest.
